captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a planetary gear bearing assembly, shown from the outside as a solid, smooth cylindrical puck with flat top and bottom surfaces. The outer ring gear forms a protective casing, completely enclosing the internal sun and planet gears. A small, stylized monogram or logo is debossed into the curved outer surface of the cylinder.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, 3D-printable planetary gear bearing system in OpenSCAD. The system should feature a solid outer ring gear, a central sun gear, and multiple planetary gears, with adjustable parameters for outer diameter, thickness, clearance, tooth profiles, shaft type (hex or round with a flat), and the number of planets.
captions.factory: The script defines a planetary gear bearing by assembling three main components inside a union. It creates an outer ring using a cylinder minus a custom herringbone gear module and a debossed monogram. The central sun gear is generated using the herringbone module with a subtracted central shaft hole (either a hex cylinder or a cylinder with a subtracted flat-sided cube). Multiple planet gears are generated in a for-loop, translated radially, and given axial holes using a cylinder subtraction.
